title: Why Korean Phone Cameras Always Click

slides.headline: In Korea, your phone camera **can't go silent.**
slides.note: Even on mute. Every photo clicks.

slides.headline: Mute does nothing **to the shutter**
slides.body: Switch a Korean phone to silent and take a photo. It still goes click, every single time.

slides.headline: It's about **privacy**
slides.body: Camera phones made it easy to take a photo without anyone noticing. The click lets the people around you know.

slides.headline: Not a law, **but it's everywhere**
slides.body: It's an industry standard, not a law. Still, phones sold in Korea come with the sound locked on.

slides.headline: The year the click **became standard**
slides.body: Korea set the rule as camera phones took off. Twenty years later, it's still on.

slides.headline: Koreans **barely notice it**
slides.body: Most Koreans have never owned a silent camera. To them, the click is just what a photo sounds like.

slides.headline: Silent at home. **Click in Korea.**
slides.body: In most countries, mute means mute. Japan is one of the few places with the same habit.

slides.headline: So **silent camera apps** boomed
slides.body: Apps that skip the click are hugely popular, mostly for food photos in quiet cafes and sleeping babies.

slides.headline: Hear a click? **It's not broken.**
slides.body: If your phone clicks in a quiet room in Korea, nothing's wrong. That's just Korea.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.
slides.graphic: Seoul skyline at dusk, softly blurred behind the text.

caption:
In Korea, a phone camera can't go silent: every photo clicks, even on mute.

It started as a 2004 privacy standard, not a law, and phones sold in Korea still ship with the sound locked on. Silent camera apps exist for a reason.

What surprised you most about phones in another country?
reply: Fun detail: screenshots on Korean phones stay silent. Only the camera clicks, so you can save a map or a menu in total quiet. Most visitors only find out when their first photo in a quiet museum echoes across the room. What everyday sound is completely normal where you live but surprises visitors?
fact_check: 3·4·5장: 2004년 정보통신부 권고·TTA 단체표준으로 휴대폰 촬영음 의무화(법 아님, 업계 자율). 성범죄 언급은 피하고 'privacy'로만 표현.
4장: 국내 출시폰은 촬영음 고정. 해외 구입폰 동작은 기종마다 달라 본문에서 뺌.
7장: 일본도 촬영음 관행 있음(업계 자율). 'one of the few'.
8장: 무음 카메라 앱 인기는 일반적 사실. 용도(음식·아기)는 흔한 설명.
댓글: 스크린샷은 무음 — 기종·설정에 따라 다를 수 있음. 갤럭시 기본은 무음 가능.
